name: Femke de Vries
bio:
Femke developed an early fascination with motorsport, not from the roar of the engines, but from the intricate financial dance that keeps teams on the track. While her peers were collecting driver cards, she was studying team budgets and sponsorship deals. After earning a degree in economics with a specialization in sports management, she interned with a Formula 3 team, quickly proving her aptitude for balancing the books and squeezing every last drop of performance from limited resources.

At Crown Racing, Femke is known for her rigorous approach to financial planning. She meticulously tracks every expense, identifies potential cost savings, and ensures the team remains compliant with all financial regulations. What sets her apart is her ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for the engineering and management teams, bridging the gap between the pit wall and the balance sheet. She firmly believes financial discipline is the key to sustained success in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight blonde hair, often pulled back into a neat ponytail during races.
physical.description: Femke has a slender build and a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Has a small, framed photo of Ayrton Senna on her desk, which she adjusts obsessively.
Drinks only peppermint tea, believing it sharpens her focus.
